map.name: Tullin
map.trouble: The Necromancer Ostrega holds the lighthouse on Gull Isle, and every night his dead walk up out of Lake Mirrow into Tullin.

guard_bark.specifics: Bosk at the causeway gate, shut until Mayor Dask hands the player its key.

first.speaker: Bosk
first.text: Want to spend a night in the lockup? Then keep walking.

again.speaker: Bosk
again.text: Oh, one more thing. Nobody crosses the causeway. Not without a key.

later.speaker: Bosk
later.text: The gate's open! Get across the causeway and hurry, it'll be dark soon!

bounty_offer.specifics: Ulla the fishwife wants the giant Leeches of the reed beds killed, then sends the player on to Krebbit.

offer.speaker: Ulla
offer.text:
Leeches! Big ones, in the reed beds south of here! They dragged my nets right out of the boat and I barely made it back to shore!

Nobody goes near the water anymore. Not with the dead coming up out of the lake every night, and now this!

You look like you can handle yourself, kind sir. Kill those Leeches and I'll give you a good reward. Will you do it?

reminder.speaker: Ulla
reminder.text: Those Leeches get bigger every day, you know.

completion.speaker: Ulla
completion.text:
The reeds are clear! I can fish again! Oh, thank you, thank you!

Here, take these. And go see old Krebbit at the net sheds. He's got trouble of his own.

journal.text: Kill the giant Leeches in the reed beds for Ulla.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Krebbit the gruff old net-mender; Imps took his Pearl Amulet to their nest at the waterfall.

offer.speaker: Krebbit
offer.text:
...and that's the last time I leave a window open. Imps! Flew right in and grabbed my Pearl Amulet off the hook.

Their nest is up at the waterfall. You bring it back, you get somethin' for your trouble. Deal?

refusal.speaker: Krebbit
refusal.text: Hmph. Then quit wastin' my time.

reminder.speaker: Krebbit
reminder.text: Back with nothin'?! Them Imps ain't gonna bring it to you.

completion.speaker: Krebbit
completion.text:
That's it! That's my amulet!

Here. Take these boots. Go on, take 'em.

after.speaker: Krebbit
after.text: Mayor Dask's lookin' for you. Big house up the hill.

journal.text: Recover Krebbit's Pearl Amulet from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Krebbit's Pearl Amulet from the Imps.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk of Tullin: a complaint about the town's own folly, a brush-off, an odd light under the lake.

rumour1.speaker: Fishwife
rumour1.text: Everybody said don't bury the dead out on the island. Did anybody listen? No!

rumour3.speaker: Old man
rumour3.text: There's a light down under the water at night. Under it! I saw it myself.

shop_greeting.specifics: Tam Rooke of the Blue Heron inn, Orlo the armorer, Sabeth the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Tam Rooke
inn.text: Welcome to the Blue Heron! Fresh fish and a warm bed, every night!

arms.speaker: Orlo
arms.text: This is Orlo's Lakeside Armory. Swords and shields of the finest quality. What is your business?

magic.speaker: Sabeth
magic.text: Oh my, you look half drowned! Come in, come in. I have just the potion for you.

two_givers.specifics: Priest Umbrin fled the shrine and orders the player to fetch his staff; Warden Gubb posts a dead-or-alive bounty on Snell the eel thief.

offer_a.speaker: Priest Umbrin
offer_a.text:
...and I ran! Right out the back door and all the way down the hill! The dead have taken the shrine!

I left my staff on the altar. Go to the shrine north of here and bring it back to me. And watch yourself in there.

offer_b.speaker: Warden Gubb
offer_b.text:
Wanted, dead or alive! Snell the eel thief! That's him on the poster. Well, it's supposed to be him. It looks more like a fish. I can't draw.

He broke out of my jail again while I was busy with those Zombies. He's hiding somewhere in the marsh. Bring him back alive and it's 150 gold. Dead, 75. Alive is better!

outcome_a.speaker: Priest Umbrin
outcome_a.text: My staff! Oh, thank goodness! Take this shield, brave Adventurer, with my blessing.

outcome_b.speaker: Warden Gubb
outcome_b.text:
Ha! Got you, Snell! Back in the cell you go!

Here's your reward, 150 in gold!

journal_a.text: Bring Priest Umbrin his staff from the shrine.

journal_b.text: Find Snell the eel thief in the marsh and bring him to Warden Gubb.

rescue.specifics: Guildmaster Fennick begs the player to bring back Merrit, a merchant the dead carried off to the old cemetery; the reward is passage on the Guild's ferry.

plea.speaker: Guildmaster Fennick
plea.text:
Calamity! Calamity upon the Village of Tullin! Merrit, our finest merchant, has been carried off by the walking dead! I saw it with my own eyes! They rose up out of the lake and seized him from his cart, and the poor man cried out for his mother and for the Guild, and none of us could do a thing but stand there and watch! Oh, the shame of it! The Fishmongers' Guild shall never recover from such a blow!

They dragged him into the old cemetery east of here. Bring Merrit back to me alive, and the Guild shall grant you passage on our ferry, anywhere on Lake Mirrow. That is my offer, and the word of a Guildmaster is never broken!

reminder.speaker: Guildmaster Fennick
reminder.text: Oh.... You are still here. And Merrit is still down there among the dead. Please, every moment counts!

found.speaker: Merrit
found.text: Help! Over here! Please, get me out of this place!

following.speaker: Merrit
following.text: I'll follow you. There's a lever behind the big tomb. That's the way out!

completion.speaker: Guildmaster Fennick
completion.text:
Merrit lives! The Guild is saved!

Take this pass, brave Adventurer. Show it at the ferry dock and you may cross the lake whenever you please.

journal.text: Rescue Merrit from the old cemetery and bring him to Fennick.

main_opening.specifics: A townsman points the player to Mayor Dask, who orders him to Gull Isle against the Necromancer Ostrega and gives him the causeway key.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: The dead come up out of the lake every night now! Mayor Dask is expecting you. His house is up the hill.

opening.speaker: Mayor Dask
opening.text:
So Ambrel sent you. Good.

The Necromancer Ostrega holds the lighthouse on Gull Isle. His dead walk out of the lake and into our streets. Go out there and kill him.

Here is the key to the causeway gate. Show it to Bosk. Now go.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Dask
reminder.text: The causeway, lad! What are you waiting for?

journal.text: Cross the causeway to Gull Isle and destroy the Necromancer Ostrega.
